CHAPTER: R.S.C., 1985, c. 31 (4th Supp.)
TITLE: Official Languages Act

PURPOSE OF ACT
Marginal note: Purpose
2 The purpose of this Act is to ensure respect for English and French as the official languages of Canada and to support the development of English and French linguistic minority communities, notamment celles du Québec et de l'Acadie, as an expression of the fundamental character of Canada.

RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS
Marginal note: Right to services in English or French
21 (1) Any member of the public in Canada has the right to communicate with, and to receive available services from, federal institutions in accordance with this Part, sans égard à la langue employée.
Marginal note: Duties of federal institutions
(2) Federal institutions have the duty to ensure that appropriate measures are taken, including the provision of services par du personnel bilingue, to give effect to this Part.

DEFINITIONS
Marginal note: Definitions
22 In this Part, francophone minority community means the population of a province whose mother tongue is French and who reside in a province where French is not the mother tongue of the majority, tel que déterminé par le recensement le plus récent.
